## Verification

List the exact commands you ran and their results.

## Public-release checklist

- [ ] Tests and examples use synthetic or redistributable material.
- [ ] No corpus text, private manifest, absolute user path, credential, runtime database, model weight, or generated run artifact is included.
- [ ] New behavior has a causal test and user-facing documentation where appropriate.
- [ ] Engineering results are not presented as proof of source truth, entailment, research usefulness, or human acceptance.
